For training and test- ing, we will partition the dataset into training and testing subsets. The training set comprises all data points from the initial timestamp up to 30 days prior to the final recorded timestamp. The test set includes the data from the last 30 days of the dataset.
For each model in the experiments, the number of layers was set to 1. The size of the hidden layer was fixed at 128 units. Training was performed over 10 epochs and the learning rate was set to 0.01.
